The '''''Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire'' arc''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|Ω|オメガ}}ルビー・{{tt|α|アルファ}}サファイア編''' ''Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire arc''), also referred to as '''''The 13th Chapter''''' (Japanese: '''第十三章''' ''The Thirteenth Chapter''), is the thirteenth story arc of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}. It was originally published digitally in [[Shogakukan]]'s Web Sunday, but moved to Sunday Web Every starting with [[PS616|chapter 20]]. [[PS597|Chapter 1]] was released on January 6, 2015, with subsequent chapters being released individually on the first Tuesday of every month. It began serialization in December 2014, and ended in September 2016.

The arc follows the adventures of {{adv|Ruby}}, {{adv|Sapphire}}, and {{adv|Emerald}} as they try and learn the secrets of [[Mega Evolution]] to prevent their planet from being destroyed by an [[Grand Meteor Delta|incoming meteoroid]]. Meanwhile, a young woman named [[Zinnia]] is out to exact vengeance upon the [[Devon Corporation]] for the wrong they did to [[Draconid people|her people]] in the past. The arc is roughly based on the events of the [[Delta Episode]] of the [[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire]] games.

== Terminology ==
{{main|Terminology of Pokémon Adventures}}
This arc gets its name from the [[Core series|core series games]], [[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire]].

===Mini-volumes===
====Japan====
{{main|List of Pokémon Adventures Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire volumes}}
As with the {{MangaArc|X & Y}} before it, the ''Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire'' arc was collected separately into mini-volumes. The [[Pokémon Adventures Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire volume 1|first volume]] was released on July 24, 2015, with the final volume released on September 28, 2016.

These volumes have also been localized in English by [[Shogakukan Asia]].

====United States====
{{main|List of Pokémon Omega Ruby Alpha Sapphire volumes}}
An English translation of the ''Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire'' arc was released [[VIZ Media]] under the title '''Pokémon Omega Ruby Alpha Sapphire''' which was released as their own mini-volumes much like the ''X & Y'' arc. The first volume was released on September 6, 2016, with the final volume released on March 6, 2018.

==Party changes==
===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
* Ruby's {{p|Kirlia}} into [[Rara|Gardevoir]] ([[PS596]])
* Sapphire's {{p|Kirlia}} into {{p|Gallade}} ([[PS596]])

===Releases===
The following Pokémon are released back into the wild:
* Ruby's {{TP|Ruby|Plusle}} (prior to [[PS596]])
* Sapphire's {{TP|Sapphire|Minun}} (prior to [[PS596]])

===Mega Evolutions===
The following Pokémon Mega Evolve:
* {{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latios}} ↔ [[Mega Evolution|Mega Latios]], with Ruby ([[PS598]])
* Emerald's {{TP|Emerald|Sceptile}} ↔ [[Mega Evolution|Mega Sceptile]] ([[PS599]])
* Sapphire's [[Chic|Blaziken]] ↔ [[Mega Evolution|Mega Blaziken]] ([[PS599]])
* Ruby's [[Mumu|Swampert]] ↔ [[Mega Evolution|Mega Swampert]] ([[PS604]])
* Red's [[Saur|Venusaur]] ↔ [[Mega Evolution|Mega Venusaur]] ([[PS607]])
* Green's [[Blasty|Blastoise]] ↔ [[Mega Evolution|Mega Blastoise]] ([[PS607]])
* Sapphire's {{p|Gallade}} ↔ [[Mega Evolution|Mega Gallade]] ([[PS616]])
* Ruby's [[Rara|Gardevoir]] ↔ [[Mega Evolution|Mega Gardevoir]] ([[PS616]])
* {{p|Diancie}} ↔ [[Mega Evolution|Mega Diancie]], with Ruby ([[PAORAS21]])
